name.zh: GaN 俘获、热与供电记忆

description.en: Linear voltage-envelope gain before compression.
description.zh: 进入压缩前的线性电压包络增益。

description.en: Output-envelope ceiling of the soft limiter; lowering it increases compression.
description.zh: 软限幅的输出包络上限；减小它会增强压缩。

description.en: Higher values produce a sharper transition into saturation.
description.zh: 值越大，从线性区进入饱和区的转折越尖锐。

description.en: Occupied trap state reduces envelope gain by 1 − κt·qₜ.
description.zh: 已占据的俘获状态通过 1 − κt·qₜ 降低包络增益。

label.zh: 俘获 / 电流崩塌强度

description.en: Charging time when envelope excitation exceeds the current trap state.
description.zh: 包络激励超过当前俘获状态时的充电时间。

description.en: Recovery time at 25 °C. Heating changes it through the activation-energy term.
description.zh: 25 °C 下的恢复时间；温升通过激活能项改变该时间。

description.en: Controls how strongly temperature accelerates trap emission; illustrative effective energy.
description.zh: 控制温度对释放速度的影响，属于示意性的有效激活能。

description.en: Phase rotation per unit of occupied trap state.
description.zh: 每单位俘获占据状态产生的相移。

description.en: Response time of the effective single-pole temperature state.
description.zh: 等效单极点温度状态的响应时间。

description.en: Reference ambient temperature; affects gain and trap emission in this virtual PA.
description.zh: 参考环境温度，影响虚拟 PA 的增益与俘获释放。

description.en: Temperature rise at unit normalized envelope excitation, not a calibrated junction-temperature prediction.
description.zh: 单位归一化包络激励下的温升，不是经过校准的结温预测。

description.en: Exponential gain reduction per kelvin relative to 25 °C.
description.zh: 相对于 25 °C，每开尔文温升导致的指数增益下降。

description.en: Envelope-dependent supply sag; ρ = 0 removes this bias-memory contribution.
description.zh: 随包络变化的供电压降；ρ = 0 会关闭这部分偏置记忆。

description.en: Response time of the supply-droop envelope state.
description.zh: 供电压降包络状态的响应时间。

description.en: A carrier path plus a delayed-turn-on peaking path for studying the AM/AM knee and path mismatch in infrastructure PAs.
description.zh: 主放大通路叠加延迟开启的峰值通路，用于研究基站 PA 的 AM/AM 拐点和通路失配。

limitations.en: Illustrative complex-baseband behavior, with normalized amplitudes. Defaults are not extracted from a specific device; no calibrated RF power, efficiency or transistor-level prediction. This envelope construction does not solve an impedance inverter or predict load modulation/efficiency.
limitations.zh: 归一化幅度的复基带示意模型。默认参数未从具体器件提取，不代表校准射频功率、效率或晶体管级预测。 该包络构造不求解阻抗变换网络，也不预测真实负载调制或效率。
